highlights_headline: The next m156 update corrects clipped path rasterization, glyph replay and Graphite pixel readback.
highlights_body: These native servicing changes leave managed APIs and package versions unchanged.

bullets.detail: Corrects anti-aliased convex path rasterization across vertical clip gaps, bounds additive-blitter runs and uses saturating fixed-point arithmetic for far-offscreen edges.

Validates serialized Slug data and direct-mask replay, preserves creation-time rounding, and retains fallbacks for unsuitable glyphs. Also corrects Ganesh path bounds and coverage-mask clamping, plus Graphite clip keys and wedge bounds.
Corrects pixel-size and row-stride handling when transferring an alpha texture to an RGBx destination, ensuring every destination pixel bit is written.
